how: checks/web_wf24_wf25.py F3, against B1945's table (main's arc, extended precision, heights 24 to 80), cell by cell in the seat's convention E = 2k: at the mark, up (3/5, 1) in S and (3/5, 8/5) in S~, down and leptons (2/5, 11/10) and (2/5, 13/10); at the twin, up (1/5, 6/5) and (1/5, 1), down as at the mark. So the act's line splits into mark and twin on the up sector only. The cells the seat's double-precision run left unsettled are the ones its referee's limits and B1945 settle, at the same values. The points with a = 0 carry a power of Im tau, as B1945 found (rates 1/2 and 1 there). The ratios of exponents are arithmetic: 5/3 and 11/4 within a sector, 3/2 and 10/11 between sectors
note: B1945 section 1b recorded the agreement where the seat's run had converged; this adds the referee's limits and the twin. The exponents are a second computation of B1945 and B1945 is theirs.
